name: CNGR Advanced Material Co., Ltd.
summary: CNGR Advanced Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of battery new materials. The company offers ternary precursors; cobaltosic oxide; binary and multicomponent precussors; iron phosphate; LFP; and sodium-ion battery precusors, as well as nickel, cobalt, and phosphorus cathode, lithium carbonate, and hydroxycobalt. The company's products are used in 3C digital products, power, and energy storage. It operates in China, Europe, America, Japan, and Korea. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tongren, the People's Republic of China.
